hooks.name: Installed Power Request Router
hooks.description: Routes requests to the smallest relevant installed power without unrelated activation.

action.prompt: Match each request to the smallest installed power: design-system-power-builder, nova-act, postman, context7, exa, datadog, ltm-power, cubic-code-review, kane-cli, cloudinary, or supabase-hosted. For architecture impact analysis use the graph-impact skill (scripts/graph-impact.mjs), not an external power. Activate only when needed; if none matches, proceed without activation. For Postman, inspect .postman.json first, use Postman MCP only, avoid duplicate resources, and validate Collection Format v2.1.0.
